JUST GETTING STARTED?

Three commands to know.

The first useful flow starts with a player, a price and a target.

01

Find your card.

Type /price, start entering a name and choose the exact version from autocomplete. Card images and ratings help you pick the right item.

02

Set your target.

Use /alert for an at-or-below or at-or-above coin target. The button on a price result opens a quick below-price alert form.

03

Keep control.

Use /myalerts to see saved targets, and /removealert with its ID to cancel. Allow private messages so notifications can reach you.

PRIVACY & DEMO DATA

Know what you’re trying.

  • The marketing pages don’t collect payment details or connect to your EA or Discord account.
  • The dashboard demo stores watchlists, example alerts, feed settings and appearance choices in your browser. Its reset control removes those demo choices.
  • Example prices, chart series, activity and illustrated memberships are not live market or customer data.
  • The Lavia and Witzig card artwork comes from the supplied catalogue. Production data and a full privacy policy will be configured before account signup opens.
